name: Camping Edelweiss
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Edelweiss is located in Neustift im Stubaital. Its location is defined by the surrounding Stubaier Alps. In winter, guests can easily reach the Stubaier Gletscher ski area via nearby access routes. In summer, the hiking trails around the area serve as perfect starting points for tours. The facilities include campsites with electric hookups and sanitary amenities. The atmosphere is shaped by the peaceful, alpine surroundings, making it an ideal base for outdoor activities.
